reserveReview.rationale: Gnosis documents that the completed migration replaced DAI and sDAI with USDS and sUSDS as xDAI bridge collateral. Timestamp-aligned reads at Ethereum block 25584913 (2026-07-22T01:13:47Z) and Gnosis block 47325357 (2026-07-22T01:13:50Z) reconcile the two sides. The Foreign Bridge held 705,559.039085990130672328 liquid USDS and 64,994,123.730852270706889290 sUSDS shares redeemable for 71,738,483.035424911185310499 USDS; only 0.052688189469517749 legacy DAI and zero sDAI remained. On Gnosis, BlockRewardAuRa mintedTotallyByBridge(Home Bridge) was 1,327,754,383.519273030164275956 xDAI and Home Bridge totalBurntCoins was 1,255,997,803.184027289689191742, leaving 71,756,580.335245740475084214 bridge-minted xDAI outstanding. Direct USDS plus the bridge's recorded 71,729,444.626685023633523932 USDS sUSDS principal and DAI dust total 72,435,003.718459203233714009, exceeding that liability by 678,423.383213462758629795 (100.95% principal coverage); max-withdrawable fair value is 72,444,042.127199090785500576. The fair-value composition normalizes to 99.03% sUSDS and 0.97% liquid USDS; legacy DAI is immaterial dust, not a reserve slice.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Timestamp-aligned Ethereum bridge escrow balances and sUSDS max-withdraw/principal reads reconciled to Gnosis bridge mint-minus-burn accounting
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material reserve constituent remains unidentified; 0.052688189469517749 legacy DAI remains as quantified dust after the completed migration.
